title: Howler Context + Skill Fabric, Phase 0-2
summary: Development-infrastructure-only work: a lean AGENTS.md router, a compact accepted-history receipt through Task 13, a routable context catalog, four canonical repo-local development skills under .agents/skills/, and a deterministic context packer (tools/context-pack/) with no embeddings/vector search. Does not modify Howler runtime behavior and does not start Task 14.
